newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Spain's INECO to design Moscow-Petersburg railway.
newsitem.headline: Spain's INECO to design Moscow-Petersburg railway.

text.p: Russia's RAO Vysokoskorostnye Magistrali (VSM, or High-Speed Railways) has chosen Spain's INECO to design its high-speed rail link betweeen Moscow and St Petersburg, VSM said on Monday.
"INECO was chosen the general designer of the VSM St Petersburg-Moscow link after a tender in which five companies, including a Russian one, participated," VSM said in a statement.
INECO's main founder is Spanish National Railways, it said.
VSM did not mention the cost of the design project, but said Spain's bank Santander would issue a credit to cover 85 percent of it and VSM would pay for the rest.

VSM plans to issue 200 billion roubles ($35 million) in government-backed bonds in the autumn in addition to previous issues of 510 billion roubles to raise funds for the $5.0-$5.5 billion railway project.
It also plans to issue a Eurobond in 1998.
